messages:
anya: Heads-up — planning a FK roll for orders.customer_id -> customers.id during the change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Table ~450M rows. Plan is: create index concurrently, add FK as NOT VALID, then VALIDATE in a throttled job. Need runbook, app version pin, and rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: @anya migration job queued for 2025-12-05 02:00:00 UTC (prod). Job id: mig-20251205-02-fk. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/mig-20251205-02-fk :gear:

sam: +1 on CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY first. important: run the index outside tx. also plan for I/O and long validate scan. We should pre-compute row counts and estimate time.

marta: Suggest using ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID, then run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in small batches with a background worker that skips ranges. Example pattern below. Also we should pin API schema in the app for 1 hour around the change.

sam: quick snippet (notes inline):
```sql
-- 1) build index (non-blocking but long)
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_customer_id ON orders(customer_id);

-- 2) add FK without validating existing rows (minimal blocking)
ALTER TABLE orders ADD CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id) NOT VALID;

-- 3) validate in chunks (this is a heavy sequential scan if naive)
-- approach: run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT on primary key ranges or use pg_background to spawn workers
VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer;
```
Note: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY must be run outside a transaction; VALIDATE can be throttled.

david: We should canary the validate step on a restored snapshot in staging with similar size first. Also pre-warm replicas and ensure pgbouncer has high pool size so app doesn't pile up connections during validate.

anya: For app deploy: plan to pin to commit a37f9c5 that has retries for FK violations and a feature flag to disable client-side checks if needed. If VALIDATE fails, we'll roll back to pinned commit until we fix.

marta: Backout plan: 1) stop validate workers; 2) DROP CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer (fast) OR set app to compatibility mode; 3) if index causes trouble, drop index concurrently. Make sure to notify customers via status page if we need >5m maintenance.

sam: operational notes:
- Run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY during off-peak (02:00 UTC).
- Monitor disk bloat; have autovacuum tuned or pause it for the index run if needed (careful).
- VALIDATE will generate seq scans — throttle by running validate on primary key ranges: e.g. WHERE id BETWEEN x AND y or using pg_sleep between batches.

deploy-bot: Migration job mig-20251205-02-fk status: scheduled -> awaiting runbook acknowledgement. Tagging oncall.

alex-oncall: I'm oncall for that window, I'll be at my desk. I'll pre-warm read replicas, raise pgbouncer max_client_conn to 12000, and have a kill-switch in place: `DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_orders_customer;` reachable from the runbook. :white_check_mark:

anya: Thanks all — I'll put the runbook in the job (step-by-step, rollback snippets, monitoring thresholds). Please review and ack so deploy-bot can move job to ready. :thumbsup:
